mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phoneNumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date , u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark,u.personalProfile,u.qqNumber,u.parent_id,u.user_type, u.is_blacklist,u.place, u.idcard,u.contact,u.ch_name,u.weComId, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from VRS_user u left join VRS_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join VRS_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join VRS_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phoneNumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by,u.idcard, u.create_time, u.remark, d.dept_name, d.leader,u.parent_id,u.user_type,u.is_blacklist from VRS_user u left join VRS_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join VRS_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id left join VRS_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and r.role_id = 144 and u.status = '0'

select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, ifnull(u.phoneNumber,"") phoneNumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by,ifnull(u.idcard,"") idcard, u.create_time, u.remark,u.parent_id,u.user_type,u.is_blacklist,u.weComId from VRS_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and u.user_id = #{userId}

select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.email, u.avatar, ifnull(u.phoneNumber,"") phoneNumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by,ifnull(u.idcard,"") idcard, u.create_time, u.remark,u.parent_id,u.user_type,u.is_blacklist from VRS_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and u.idcard = #{idcard}

select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phoneNumber, u.status, u.create_time,u.user_type,u.is_blacklist from VRS_user u left join VRS_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join VRS_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where r.role_id = #{roleId} and u.user_id = #{userId}

select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phoneNumber, u.status, u.create_time,u.user_type,u.is_blacklist from VRS_user u left join VRS_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join VRS_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join VRS_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from VRS_user u inner join VRS_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
